Why Did Japanese Baseball Split into the Central and Pacific Leagues?

Why are there two leagues in Japanese professional baseball? Geography and playing strength were not the original dividing lines. In 1949, disagreement over admitting new clubs split the eight established teams into two camps. The first season had eight Central League clubs and seven Pacific League clubs. 球団再編、DH制、2004年の球界再編、交流戦、パ・リーグの共同事業を通じて、二つのリーグが分かれて競争しながら協働する仕組みを読み解く。
